fixes.was: A for-cause restriction on the President's power to remove the single Director of an agency is unconstitutional, but the defect does not automatically void the agency's actions; retrospective relief depends on whether the restriction caused compensable harm.
fixes.now: Applying Seila Law, the for-cause restriction on the President's removal of the FHFA's confirmed Director is unconstitutional, but that defect does not automatically void the agency's actions; retrospective relief depends on whether the restriction caused compensable harm.
